description: This file defines the ConceptService interface in the OpenMRS API, detailing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting concepts, drugs, concept classes, mappings, and related entities. It includes extensive documentation and security annotations for role-based access control.

classes.name: ConceptService
classes.description: Interface defining the core operations for managing concepts, drugs, concept classes, mappings, and related entities within the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, searches, and index updates, all secured with role-based annotations.

methods.name: setConceptDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO used for accessing concept data in the database.

methods.name: getConceptByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept by its UUID.

methods.name: saveConcept
methods.description: Saves or updates a concept in the database.

methods.name: saveDrug
methods.description: Saves or updates a drug in the database.

methods.name: purgeConcept
methods.description: Completely removes a concept from the database.

methods.name: retireConcept
methods.description: Retires a concept, removing it from active use.

methods.name: retireDrug
methods.description: Retires a drug, removing it from active use.

methods.name: unretireDrug
methods.description: Reactivates a retired drug.

methods.name: purgeDrug
methods.description: Permanently deletes a drug.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Retrieves a concept by its ID.

methods.name: getConceptName
methods.description: Retrieves a concept name by its ID.

methods.name: getConceptAnswer
methods.description: Retrieves a concept answer by its ID.

methods.name: getDrug
methods.description: Retrieves a drug by its ID.

methods.name: getConceptNumeric
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric concept by its ID.

methods.name: getConceptClass
methods.description: Retrieves a concept class by its ID.

methods.name: getAllConcepts
methods.description: Returns a list of all unretired concepts.

methods.name: getAllConcepts
methods.description: Returns a list of all concepts with optional sorting and inclusion of retired concepts.

methods.name: getConceptsByName
methods.description: Finds concepts matching the provided name.

methods.name: getConceptByName
methods.description: Finds a concept with an exact matching name.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Convenience method to retrieve a concept by ID or name.

methods.name: getConceptByReference
methods.description: Retrieves a concept based on varied reference identifiers such as UUID, ID, name.

methods.name: getDrugByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a drug by UUID.

methods.name: getDrugIngredientByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a drug ingredient by UUID.

methods.name: getDrug
methods.description: Retrieves a drug by name or ID.

methods.name: getAllDrugs
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-retired drugs.

methods.name: getDrugsByConcept
methods.description: Finds drugs associated with a particular concept.

methods.name: getAllDrugs
methods.description: Returns all drugs, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getDrugs
methods.description: Finds drugs based on a search phrase.

methods.name: getConceptsByClass
methods.description: Finds concepts by their class.

methods.name: getConceptClassByName
methods.description: Retrieves a concept class by name.

methods.name: getAllConceptClasses
methods.description: Lists all concept classes, including or excluding retired.

methods.name: getConceptClassByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept class by UUID.

methods.name: getConceptAnswerByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept answer by UUID.

methods.name: getConceptNameByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept name by UUID.

methods.name: getConceptSetByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept set by UUID.

methods.name: getConceptSourceByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept source by UUID.
